instruction: VS Code inspects PRODUCTION and reports VERIFIED / PARTIAL / MISSING per item with evidence (file, route, event name, screenshot of the diagnostics page). Do not assume any item is present because behavioural intelligence exists. A paid campaign is not ready because Meta/Google can accept an advertisement; readiness = the Director can measure downstream Advantage.Bid outcomes for that campaign's success signal.

items.requirement: Meta Pixel installed on all public pages with PageView; base code present in the production template
Meta Conversions API server-side events with event_id deduplication against the pixel
items.how_to_verify: inspect server code + Events Manager diagnostics

items.requirement: fbclid captured on landing and persisted (cookie/first-party store) → _fbc/_fbp available to CAPI
Google Ads conversion tag or GA4-linked conversions with conversion actions defined
gclid / gbraid / wbraid captured on landing and persisted (≥ 90 days)
first-party campaign/session attribution: session record with landing URL, referrer, campaign id, click ids, timestamps; first-touch and last-touch stored
utm_source/medium/campaign/content/term captured and persisted on the session and carried to registration
instrumented events: page_view, search, lot_view, watch_lot, bid, purchase, auction_draft_created, auction_published, seller_inquiry, assisted_service_inquiry, email_signup
anonymous session id linked to the user id at registration/login; prior anonymous events re-attributed
anonymous-to-known attribution policy (which anonymous activity may be attributed after registration; retention; legal basis)
consent banner/state honoured by pixel, CAPI and first-party tracking; consent stored per session/user
suppression lists: converted buyers/sellers excluded from acquisition audiences; unsubscribe/opt-out honoured; hashed uploads governed
first-party audience generation (site visitors, lot viewers, cart/draft abandoners) exported to providers under consent
conversion events defined once, shared by first-party, Meta and Google (registration, seller_inquiry, auction_published, purchase) with values where appropriate
daily campaign cost ingestion from Meta Ads and Google Ads APIs into marketing_performance_facts
provider-reported conversions reconciled to first-party outcomes; discrepancies recorded, never silently averaged
campaign → session → user → marketplace action → transaction/seller outcome joined with attribution classes DELIVERED / MEASURED / INFLUENCED / ATTRIBUTION_UNAVAILABLE
Director-accessible performance facts with the signal-state model and checkpoints; Owner report generator

minimum_for_any_paid_activation: behavioral_events (the campaign's success signal event at least)
readiness_rule.partial_allowed: a PARTIAL item may be accepted for a bounded experiment (≤ $100) if the Director records what cannot be measured and the Owner report says so

first_party_truth: Meta and Google are acquisition/measurement destinations; the authority for marketplace outcomes is Advantage.Bid's own event and transaction data.
